name: Base rate (B0)
harness: share met at the deadline among earlier company trials whose first result came within the same window after primary completion and that were followed for all of it, shrunk towards the share in B1's fit (make_baselines.py)

name: Registry model (B1)
harness: B0's matched rate moved by a logistic regression on 7 registry fields (C = 0.1), kept within [0.05, 0.95] (make_baselines.py)

name: Claude Opus 5.5
harness: One agent per batch of up to 10 trials, given the round's instructions unchanged and the batch's packets, and told to use only the tools to read those two files and write its answers; no web. The organiser checks every log (tools used, files read and written, the model that replied) and re-runs any batch that used another tool or was answered by another model.
